item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
Automatic updates.

  • New: Check for Updates… in the TalkKey menu. TalkKey also checks once a day and offers new versions with one-click Install and Relaunch.
  • Updates are signed and verified before installing.
  • Includes 0.4.0's two hotkeys (F15 and fn by default).

If you have 0.4.0 or earlier, download this version once; after that, updates come to you.
